indicators.section: Indicators to detect, prevent, and report this scam
indicators.flag: Promises of high or guaranteed investment or donation returns for payments made to accounts with which you have no prior business relationship.
indicators.red_flag: Guaranteed-return solicitation to no-relationship payee (CVC double-your-money scam)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Indicators to detect, prevent, and report this scam
indicators.flag: Communications, including social media posts, soliciting payments with misspellings or messages out of profile for the counterparty, soliciting payments from individuals or organizations with whom you have no prior existing business relationship, including celebrities or public figures.
indicators.red_flag: Out-of-profile / misspelled solicitation impersonating a public figure (compromised-account spoof)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: Indicators to detect, prevent, and report this scam
indicators.flag: Solicitations requesting donations via social media where the solicitor is not affiliated with a reputable organization.
indicators.red_flag: Donation solicitation from unaffiliated / non-reputable entity
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: Indicators to detect, prevent, and report this scam
indicators.flag: Social media posts that solicit donations or advertise give-aways that appear from accounts that are not “verified” through the social media platform account verification processes or that misspell the celebrity or financial institution’s name.
indicators.red_flag: Unverified / name-misspelling impersonation account soliciting give-away payments
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: Indicators to detect, prevent, and report this scam
indicators.flag: Multiple social media accounts communicating the same message soliciting funds for an unknown purpose or to an unknown account.
indicators.red_flag: Coordinated multi-account same-message fund solicitation (amplification ring)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Indicators to detect, prevent, and report this scam
indicators.flag: Communications, including social media posts, that provide the same CVC address across multiple celebrity or prominent financial institution social media accounts.
indicators.red_flag: Single shared CVC wallet address across multiple impersonation accounts (funnel-in deposit address)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.
